scraped.scraped_description: HURIDOCS equips human rights defenders with tools to mobilise information for justice and accountability. - HURIDOCS

name: HURIDOCS
tagline: HURIDOCS equips human rights defenders with tools to mobilise information for justice and accountability
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
known_funders: Principality of Liechtenstein Office for Foreign Affairs
dependency_risks: flagship tool Uwazi requires ongoing technical maintenance

awards.name: Recognition as leading human rights documentation platform

policy_outcomes.description: HURIDOCS Events Standard Formats (1993) became the methodology base for human rights violation documentation globally
Uwazi used by human rights organisations worldwide for case documentation and evidence management
Human rights documentation support in Ukraine following Russian invasion

outcome_methodology: Case studies and user testimonials from partner organizations; documented usage in accountability processes
published_performance_metrics: GitHub activity metrics; user adoption statistics across partner organizations; case documentation volumes
documented_limitations: tools require technical capacity to deploy and maintain
documentation work does not guarantee legal accountability outcomes
failure_modes: tool adoption barriers in low-resource contexts
data security risks for human rights defenders in repressive environments
sustainability risk if core funders withdraw
governance_model: Swiss NGO with Board of Advisors; Geneva office with distributed global team; open source tools under permissive licences
curation_criteria: Open source contribution guidelines on GitHub; community-driven standards development for human rights documentation; peer review of tool features and updates
contributor_governance: Open source repositories on GitHub (37+ repos); contributions accepted via standard GitHub workflow
community_ownership: Open source; human rights community co-develops standards and tools

government_partnerships.type: grant funding for ESC rights monitoring in Turkey

government_partnerships.partner: Principality of Liechtenstein Office for Foreign Affairs

ai_involvement: Machine learning and NLP used in Uwazi (PDF layout analysis, named entity recognition, text extraction)
political_relevance_summary: HURIDOCS addresses the civic problem of supporting human rights documentation and accountability. It has documented policy impact.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizers/campaigners through HURIDOCS equips human rights defenders with tools to mobilise information for justice and accountability.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase enables replication. already deployed internationally across multiple jurisdictions.
